annotations.message: Mimir alertmanager {{ $labels.pod }} in {{ $labels.cluster }}/{{ $labels.namespace }} owns no tenants.

expressions.A:
{"model":{"datasource":{"type":"prometheus","uid":"mimir"},"expr":"# Alert on alertmanager instances in microservices mode that own no tenants,
min by(cluster, namespace, pod) (cortex_alertmanager_tenants_owned{pod=~"(.*mimir-)?alertmanager.*"}) == 0
# but only if other instances of the same cell do have tenants assigned.
and on (cluster, namespace)
max by(cluster, namespace) (cortex_alertmanager_tenants_owned) > 0","instant":false,"intervalMs":60000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"range":true,"refId":"A"},"datasource_uid":"mimir","query_type":"","relative_time_range":{"from":"10m0s","to":"0s"}}
